name: Social media - profile
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Social media - profile.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Profile content and links are manual. Global URLs use Theme Settings → Integrations. No account connection, verification badge or automatic social data is supplied.

settings.label: Avatar image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Name
settings.how: Enter the name. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Role / title
settings.how: Enter the role / title. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Short bio
settings.how: Write the short bio. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Use global social urls (theme settings → integrations)
settings.how: Turn on “Use global social urls (theme settings → integrations)” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show network labels next to icons
